name: Transition elements complex ions and ligand substitution

questions.q: What is the defining electronic configuration characteristic of transition elements in terms of their d-orbitals?
a: They are d-block elements that form one or more stable ions with incompletely filled d-orbitals
They have completely filled d-orbitals in all oxidation states
They only form compounds with s-block metals
They possess no electrons in their d-subshell

questions.q: Why do transition metal complexes often exhibit vibrant colors in aqueous solution?

questions.q: What is the chelate effect?
a: The rapid precipitation of transition metal hydroxides in alkaline media
The complete loss of color when a transition metal is heated

questions.q: What is the primary reason why transition elements exhibit variable oxidation states in their compounds?
a: Their outer s and d electrons have very similar energies, requiring relatively small differences in energy to remove varying numbers of electrons

They form giant covalent lattices exclusively
